onboarding.body: See exactly where your money goes. No judgment, no jargon — just clarity.

connect.headline:
Connect
your bank.
connect.body: We connect securely via open banking (PSD2). We never see your password or account details.
connect.security_note: Bank connection powered by Tink — the EU open banking standard.
